ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65% low-intensity pixels (black/dark gray) concentrated in the central and lower regions, and 35% high-intensity pixels (white/light gray) concentrated in the upper peripheral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity blobs located at the upper-left and upper-right quadrants. The left blob is an irregular, feathered polygon spanning approximately 25% of the lobe width. The right blob is a more elongated, horizontal polygon spanning approximately 40% of the lobe width, interrupted by distinct dark linear features.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 55 degrees; depth is approximately 8% of total fluke vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Multiple secondary notches and peaks are visible along the entire boundary; peak amplitudes vary significantly, ranging from 2 to 15 pixels relative to the local edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a complex sweep: initially concave moving outward from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve as it approaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse distribution of roughly circular white pixel clusters (approx. 3-8 pixel diameter) visible against the black central region and near the leading edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, high-contrast intersecting dark linear features located in the upper-right high-intensity blob (one vertical, one near-horizontal). Multiple fine, parallel diagonal dark streaks are visible in the upper-left high-intensity blob.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant intersecting linear scars in the right lobe's white pigmentation field; multiple small circular white marks (likely barnacle attachment points) scattered across the dark central ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive 'brush-stroke' or feathered transition pattern between the black and white regions on the medial side of the left lobe's primary pigment patch.
